supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; dominant driver, holdout R2 ~0.77 with X1-X3.

Interaction coef 0.749, p~1.5e-18, delta_r2 0.0735 over X4+X5 alone; holdout test R2 rises from ~0.77 to ~0.877 when X4:X5 is added, replicating out of sample.
Small main effect coef 0.18, p~1e-5 in linear model; its effect is largely captured by the X4:X5 interaction.

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant product term (p~1.5e-18), delta_r2 0.0735, and holdout test R2 improves from ~0.77 to ~0.877 with X4:X5; X4 and X5 are nearly uncorrelated (r=0.037), so this is not a collinearity artifact.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression and holdout results show strong association only; no design supports causal identification.
